name: Kevin J Bonnington
occupation: West Linn City Councilor; Real Estate Broker

bio.statement: The City of West Linn page lists Kevin Bonnington as a councilor with a term of March 11, 2024 to December 31, 2026.

source.publisher: City of West Linn, Councilor Kevin Bonnington page

bio.statement: The city page says Bonnington was born and raised in West Linn and has worked as a real estate broker focusing on first-time buyers since 2016.
bio.excerpt: He has worked as a Real Estate Broker, focusing on helping first time buyers get their foot in the door since 2016.

source.publisher: City of West Linn, Councilor Kevin Bonnington page

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists West Linn City Council since 2024, Planning Commission 2023-2024 and Transportation Advisory Board 2021-2022.
bio.excerpt: West Linn City Council 2024-Present; Planning Commission, 2023-2024; Transportation Advisory Board, 2021-2022

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 55, printed C-54)

bio.statement: Bonnington's pamphlet statement lists a University of Oregon BA in Political Science/Business from 2009.
bio.excerpt: University of Oregon, Political Science/Business, BA 2009

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 55, printed C-54)

positions.statement: Bonnington says he has worked to better include everyone in the conversation about matters under consideration at City Hall.

positions.statement: Bonnington says consequential decisions about West Linn should continue to be made in West Linn.
